title: Invalid signature
demonstrates: Only a valid signature from a trusted, unrevoked key in the right role is accepted.

variants.title: Corrupt one bit of the signature
evidence: V3 FAIL: signature does not match the manifest payload

variants.title: Replay a signature from another manifest
variants.attack: valid base-model signature pasted into the final-model envelope
evidence: V3 FAIL: signature does not match the manifest payload

variants.title: Sign with an unregistered key
variants.attack: manifest re-signed by an attacker-generated Ed25519 key
evidence: V3 FAIL: signing key ed25519:646aa39833a3c488 is not in the trust store

variants.title: Signature by a revoked key
evidence: V4 FAIL: key revoked at 2026-10-15T21:45:20.112651Z (simulated key compromise)

variants.title: Trusted key used outside its role
variants.attack: data_steward key signs a model while claiming training_pipeline
evidence: V4 FAIL: manifest claims role 'training_pipeline' but key is registered for 'data_steward'; manifest claims identity 'training_pipeline@chainguard.local' but key belongs to 'data_steward@chainguard.local'; role 'data_steward' may not sign stage3_finetune artifacts (allowed: training_pipeline)

variants.title: Malformed signature encoding
evidence: V3 FAIL: signature does not match the manifest payload
